citation: MIL-STD-810H Method 514.8 Annex F para 5.2 track-patter f=0.28*v/p with v in km/h and p in m (40 km/h, 0.194 m track pitch -> ~57.7 Hz) + harmonics. LOS-stabilization context: US 4,796,090 ('Reconnaissance system', airborne LOS stabilization; NOTE: its ~10 urad figure is explicitly PEAK-TO-PEAK; divide by ~2.8 for RMS comparisons).
notes: High-frequency track-patter buzz; smear-dominated at the default exposure. The 35 urad default reads the low end of the 25-250 urad medium-quality-gimbal class (Miller, Mooty & Hilkert, in Rodin et al. 2019) as a stabilized-sight ground-vehicle residual.
